pages.title: Quantum Lithographer
pages.text: Engraves logic onto wafers through a lens. The lens is a catalyst and is never consumed.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

Photolithography as industry does it: coat the wafer in light-sensitive $(thing)photoresist$(), shine a pattern through a lens, and wash away what the light touched. The finer the light, the finer the lines. My later lenses are not really made of anything that bends light.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cosmic Logic Wafer, Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer, Photonic Logic Wafer, Qubit Array Wafer, Topological Logic Wafer.
